name: Coffee machine manual
document:
Corvella CM-40 bean-to-cup coffee machine: user manual

1. Important safety instructions
Read all instructions before using the machine and keep this manual for later.
- Connect the machine only to an earthed socket with the voltage given on the rating plate.
- Keep children away from the machine while it is in use.
- Do not use the machine if the cord or plug is damaged.

CAUTION: Never put the machine, the power cord or the plug in water or any other liquid.

CAUTION: Unplug the machine before you clean it or move it.

2. What is in the box
Corvella CM-40 machine, water tank (1.7 L), milk container, water hardness test strip, cleaning brush, one bottle of descaling solution, measuring scoop, and this manual.

3. Accessories
You can order these accessories from your dealer: Glass milk jug with lid; Drip tray grid; Coffee scoop with clip. Use only original accessories so that the parts fit correctly.

4. First setup
1. Place the machine on a flat, stable surface, at least 10 cm from the wall.
2. Rinse the water tank, fill it with fresh cold tap water up to the MAX line and slide it back in.
3. Fill the bean container with coffee beans.

Setting the water hardness. Hard water makes the machine scale up faster, so tell it how hard your water is. Dip the test strip in tap water for 1 second, wait 1 minute, then count the red bars:
- 1 red bar: soft water, choose hardness level 1
- 2 red bars: medium water, choose hardness level 2
- 3 red bars: hard water, choose hardness level 3
- 4 red bars: very hard water, choose hardness level 4
Open Settings > Water hardness on the display and select the level.

CAUTION: Do not fill the water tank with sparkling water or mineral water.

5. Questions and answers
Q: How do I save energy?
A: Set the automatic switch-off in Settings > Energy. The default is after 30 minutes without use.
Q: Can I change the cup sizes?
A: Yes. Each cup size can be adjusted in Settings > Cup sizes and saved as your own.
Q: Why does my coffee taste weak?
A: Choose a stronger setting or a finer grind. Very oily beans can also slow the grinder down.

6. Recipe: Flat white
Brew 80 ml of double espresso into a large cup. Add 110 ml of velvety milk. Use a tall glass to see the layers. Try it with an oat drink for a lighter taste.

7. Controls
- Power button: press to switch on. Hold it for 3 seconds to switch off.
- Strength button: cycles through mild, medium and strong.
- Cup size button: espresso, lungo or americano.
- Steam button: press to start or stop milk frothing. Hold it for 7 seconds to start the descaling program.
- Rinse button: press for a hot water rinse of the coffee spout. Hold it for 5 seconds to reset the filter counter.
- Display: shows the selected drink, messages and error codes.

8. Tips for better coffee
Taste changes with the season's beans; adjust the grind by one step at a time.

9. Brewing coffee
Cup sizes: espresso 40 ml, lungo 110 ml, americano 200 ml. Brewing temperature can be set to low (88 °C), medium (91 °C) or high (94 °C) in Settings > Temperature. The grinder has seven settings; 1 is the finest.

CAUTION: Turn the grinder setting knob only while the grinder is running.

10. Recipe: Cortado
Brew 40 ml of espresso into a large cup. Add 40 ml of warm milk. Use a tall glass to see the layers. A medium grind works best here.

11. Accessories
You can order these accessories from your dealer: Cleaning brush set; Second water tank; Travel bag. Use only original accessories so that the parts fit correctly.

12. Questions and answers
Q: Does the machine work with decaf beans?
A: Yes, any whole roasted beans work.
Q: The display is too bright at night.
A: Lower the display brightness in Settings > Display.
Q: How do I switch off the beep?
A: Turn off sounds in Settings > Sounds.

13. Tips for better coffee
A lungo is not the same as an americano: a lungo pushes more water through the coffee, an americano adds hot water after brewing.

14. Frothing milk
Fill the milk container with cold milk up to the MAX line, attach it to the machine and place a cup under the spout. Press the Steam button to start; press it again to stop. After each use, run a short burst of steam to clear the wand.

CAUTION: The steam wand is hot during and after use. Hold it only by the plastic grip.

15. Tips for better coffee
Grind just before brewing, which the machine does for you. Keep the bean container closed so the beans stay fresh.

16. Cleaning
Daily: empty the drip tray and the grounds container, and rinse the milk container. Weekly: take out the brew unit and rinse it under the tap; let it dry before you put it back. Never use a dishwasher for the brew unit.

CAUTION: The drip tray can hold hot water. Let it cool before you take it out.

17. Accessories
You can order these accessories from your dealer: Spare milk container; Bean container lid with seal; Thermal milk jug. Use only original accessories so that the parts fit correctly.

18. Descaling and the water filter
The machine counts the cups it makes and asks for descaling when the count for your hardness level is reached:
- hardness level 1: every 600 cups
- hardness level 2: every 400 cups
- hardness level 3: every 250 cups
- hardness level 4: every 150 cups
To descale, empty the drip tray, pour the descaling solution into the water tank, add water up to the MAX line and start the descaling program (see Controls). The program takes about 25 minutes. Replace the water filter every 2 months.

CAUTION: Descaling solution irritates eyes and skin. If it gets on your skin or in your eyes, rinse with plenty of water.

19. Questions and answers
Q: Why does my coffee taste bitter?
A: Try a coarser grind or a lower brewing temperature. Darker roasts taste more bitter.
Q: Why is my coffee not hot enough?
A: Warm the cup first with a hot water rinse, and choose a higher brewing temperature in the settings.
Q: Can I make two cups at once?
A: Yes. Press the cup size button twice to brew two espressos or two lungos.

20. Recipe: Vanilla latte
Brew 40 ml of espresso into a large cup. Add 180 ml of milk with a spoon of vanilla syrup. Stir once and enjoy. A medium grind works best here.

21. Accessories
You can order these accessories from your dealer: Cup tray extension; Cleaning brush set; Bean container lid with seal. Use only original accessories so that the parts fit correctly.

22. Error codes
E01 water tank empty: fill the tank.
E02 grounds container full: empty it.
E03 drip tray missing: insert the drip tray.
E05 brew unit not inserted: insert the brew unit until it clicks.
E07 bean container empty: add beans.
E09 descaling needed: start the descaling program.
E11 temperature sensor fault: contact customer service.
E12 grinder blocked: contact customer service.

CAUTION: Switch off and unplug the machine before you take out the brew unit.

23. Tips for better coffee
If you drink mostly milk drinks, a slightly stronger setting balances the milk.

24. Recipe: Americano
Brew 40 ml of espresso into a large cup. Add 160 ml of hot water. Use a tall glass to see the layers. Try it with an oat drink for a lighter taste.

25. Questions and answers
Q: Can I use ground coffee?
A: No. The CM-40 grinds whole beans only.
Q: The machine makes a loud noise when grinding.
A: A grinding noise is normal. A sharp clicking noise can mean a small stone in the beans.
Q: Where is the serial number?
A: On the rating plate behind the water tank.

26. Recipe: Mocha
Brew 40 ml of espresso into a large cup. Add 150 ml of milk with chocolate syrup. Serve straight away. Warm the cup first for a hotter drink.

27. Technical data
Power 1,450 W; voltage 220-240 V, 50/60 Hz; water tank 1.7 L; bean container 250 g; weight 8.1 kg; dimensions 24 x 43 x 36 cm.

28. Questions and answers
Q: Water drips from the spout after brewing.
A: A few drops after brewing are normal.
Q: Which beans work best?
A: Fresh beans roasted within the last few weeks. Store them in an airtight container away from light.
Q: Can I leave milk in the container?
A: Put the milk container back in the fridge between uses.

29. Accessories
You can order these accessories from your dealer: Glass milk jug with lid; Coffee scoop with clip; Travel bag. Use only original accessories so that the parts fit correctly.

30. Warranty
The machine has a two-year warranty from the date of purchase. Keep your receipt. The warranty does not cover damage from scale build-up if the machine was not descaled when it asked for it.

31. Tips for better coffee
Clean cups make better crema. Rinse cups with hot water before use.

32. Tips for better coffee
Grind just before brewing, which the machine does for you. Keep the bean container closed so the beans stay fresh.

33. Recipe: Café au lait
Brew 110 ml of lungo into a large cup. Add 110 ml of hot milk. Stir once and enjoy. Warm the cup first for a hotter drink.

34. Questions and answers
Q: The milk foam is too thin. What can I do?
A: Use cold milk straight from the fridge. Whole milk and some oat drinks make the firmest foam.
Q: Why does my coffee taste bitter?
A: Try a coarser grind or a lower brewing temperature. Darker roasts taste more bitter.
Q: Can I use ground coffee?
A: No. The CM-40 grinds whole beans only.

35. Accessories
You can order these accessories from your dealer: Cup tray extension; Spare milk container; Thermal milk jug. Use only original accessories so that the parts fit correctly.

36. Questions and answers
Q: The milk foam is too thin. What can I do?
A: Use cold milk straight from the fridge. Whole milk and some oat drinks make the firmest foam.
Q: Why does my coffee taste weak?
A: Choose a stronger setting or a finer grind. Very oily beans can also slow the grinder down.
Q: Can I change the cup sizes?
A: Yes. Each cup size can be adjusted in Settings > Cup sizes and saved as your own.
